plugins.name: blue-collar-governance-plugin
plugins.description: Deterministic governance plugin for Claude Code with fail-closed hooks, forensic history, and post-session verification.

skills.name: as-built
skills.description: Render SessionReceipt summarizeAsBuilt output as deterministic accountability delta with no writes.
skills.description_zh: 将 SessionReceipt 的 summarizeAsBuilt 输出呈现为确定的责任归属变化记录，仅渲染，不写入。

skills.name: buddy-status
skills.description: Render a read-only watcher snapshot from current policy and active callouts already recorded.
skills.description_zh: 依据当前策略及已记录的活跃提示，呈现只读监视器状态快照。

skills.name: callout
skills.description: Render a read-only callout-detail snapshot from current Buddy callouts already recorded.
skills.description_zh: 依据 Buddy 中已记录的提示，呈现只读的提示详情快照。

skills.name: census
skills.description: Render a manual local repo snapshot from explicit observable truth.
skills.description_zh: 依据明确可观察的事实，手动呈现本地仓库快照。

skills.name: chain
skills.description: Render existing ForensicChain entry history as a deterministic read/query/render-only view.
skills.description_zh: 以确定的只读查询和渲染视图呈现现有 ForensicChain 条目历史。

skills.name: change-order
skills.description: Render a read-only snapshot of existing change orders and their current recorded decision status.
skills.description_zh: 呈现已有变更单及当前已记录决策状态的只读快照。

skills.name: confidence-transitions
skills.description: Preview and explicitly append neutral confidence transition findings from explicit marker continuity compare input.
skills.description_zh: 依据明确的标记连续性比较输入，预览并经明确动作追加中性的置信度变化发现。

skills.name: confidence
skills.description: Render a read-only confidence-marker map plus optional required coverage, optional marker continuity, and optional explicit dated temporal signals from deterministic slash-marker scans inside the approved repo fence.
skills.description_zh: 在获准仓库范围内，以确定的斜杠标记扫描呈现只读置信度标记图，可附所需覆盖、标记连续性及明确注明日期的时间信号。

skills.name: constraints
skills.description: Render read-only ConstraintsRegistry posture visibility for maintained never-do rule truth.
skills.description_zh: 只读呈现 ConstraintsRegistry 中持续维护的禁止规则及其当前约束状态。

skills.name: control-rods
skills.description: Render Control Rod posture/status visibility using read/query/render-only behavior.
skills.description_zh: 以只读查询和渲染方式呈现 Control Rod 的状态与姿态。

skills.name: diagnose
skills.description: Render evidence-linked diagnostic visibility from existing Walk and Chain truth.
skills.description_zh: 依据已有 Walk 与 Chain 事实，呈现带证据链接的诊断视图。

skills.name: eliminate
skills.description: Render existing hold routes, scarcity posture, and resolution paths without adding advice.
skills.description_zh: 呈现现有暂停路线、资源稀缺状态与解决路径，不额外添加建议。

skills.name: fire-break
skills.description: Render manual governance snapshot visibility from Open Items Board truth.
skills.description_zh: 依据 Open Items Board 现有事实，呈现手动治理快照。

skills.name: gaps
skills.description: Render omission expected-signal-missing findings from existing OmissionCoverageEngine output with no writes.
skills.description_zh: 只读呈现 OmissionCoverageEngine 已有输出中的遗漏与预期信号缺失发现，不写入。

skills.name: issue-permit
skills.description_zh: 为单个 HARD_STOP 域创建或撤销 permit，记录操作者决定、范围依据、风险、回滚和条件，配合有效 LOTO clearance 供 PreToolUse 放行；不评估许可关卡或支持 v1 多域许可。

skills.name: journeyman
skills.description: Render persisted trust posture/history from shipped trust truth using pure read/query/render-only paths.
skills.description_zh: 依据已实现的信任事实，以纯只读查询和渲染方式呈现已保存的信任状态与历史。

skills.name: keystone
skills.description: Render the deterministic keystone finding from existing Foreman's Walk output.
skills.description_zh: 从现有 Foreman's Walk 输出中呈现确定的关键支点发现。

skills.name: lockout
skills.description: Validate an explicit LOTO authorization using existing Control Rod v2 validation truth and render deterministic output.
skills.description_zh: 依据现有 Control Rod v2 验证事实核验明确的 LOTO 锁定挂牌授权，并呈现确定结果。

skills.name: loto-clearance
skills.description_zh: 创建或撤销 HARD_STOP 域的 LOTO clearance，记录域、操作者、原因、会话及 SESSION/EXPIRY 范围，供 PreToolUse 钩子按范围放行；不负责许可关卡评估或修改 Control Rod。

skills.name: permit
skills.description: Evaluate an explicit HARD_STOP permit gate with current Control Rod v2 truth and render the deterministic decision output.
skills.description_zh: 依据当前 Control Rod v2 事实评估明确的 HARD_STOP 许可关卡，并呈现确定的决策结果。

skills.name: phantoms
skills.description: Render Foreman's Walk truthfulness findings (PHANTOM/GHOST/PARTIAL_VERIFICATION) using read/query/render-only behavior.
skills.description_zh: 只读呈现 Foreman's Walk 的真实性发现，包括 PHANTOM、GHOST 和 PARTIAL_VERIFICATION。

skills.name: prevention-record
skills.description: Render conservative cumulative governance history from explicit captured signals using read/query/render-only behavior.
skills.description_zh: 依据明确已捕获的信号，以只读查询和渲染方式呈现保守的累计治理历史。

skills.name: receipt
skills.description: Render session receipt truth from existing SessionReceipt read paths with no state mutation.
skills.description_zh: 通过 SessionReceipt 现有读取路径呈现会话回执事实，不修改状态。

skills.name: red-tag
skills.description: Evaluate a specific action-target pair against existing safety interlocks and render the current decision truth.
skills.description_zh: 依据已有安全联锁评估指定动作与目标的组合，并呈现当前决策事实。

skills.name: resolve
skills.description: Record a deterministic restoration action from explicit finding identity and surface continuity-safe Board projection eligibility.
skills.description_zh: 依据明确的发现标识记录确定的恢复动作，并显示符合连续性要求的 Board 投影资格。

skills.name: restoration
skills.description: Render a deterministic restoration ledger from existing Forensic Chain truth and surface continuity-only Board resolved-outcomes projection.
skills.description_zh: 依据已有 Forensic Chain 事实呈现确定的恢复台账，并展示仅涉及连续性的 Board 已解决结果投影。

skills.name: rights
skills.description: Render a static manual Bill of Rights declaration using read/query/render-only behavior.
skills.description_zh: 以只读查询和渲染方式呈现静态的手工权利宣言。

skills.name: silence-map
skills.description: Render read-only blocked/restricted/guarded posture over ConstraintsRegistry, SafetyInterlocks, and ControlRodMode posture truth.
skills.description_zh: 只读呈现 ConstraintsRegistry、SafetyInterlocks 与 ControlRodMode 中已记录的阻止、限制和保护状态。

skills.name: toolbox-talk
skills.description: Render startup carry-forward context from SessionBrief.toolboxTalk using read/query/render-only behavior.
skills.description_zh: 通过 SessionBrief.toolboxTalk 的只读查询与渲染，在启动时呈现从上次延续的上下文。

skills.name: ufo
skills.description: Render unresolved and aging Standing Risk visibility from existing StandingRiskEngine output with no writes.
skills.description_zh: 依据 StandingRiskEngine 已有输出呈现未解决及久未处理的持续风险，不写入。

skills.name: walk
skills.description: Render Foreman's Walk evaluation output for post-session verification with no engine mutation.
skills.description_zh: 呈现 Foreman's Walk 评估结果用于会话后验证，不修改引擎。

skills.name: warranty
skills.description: Render existing WarrantyMonitor derived posture views with read/query/render-only behavior.
skills.description_zh: 以只读查询和渲染方式呈现 WarrantyMonitor 已有的派生状态视图。

skills.name: work-order-intake
skills.description: Turn a plain-language Work Order start into a structured intake evaluation with deterministic HOLDs and follow-up questions.
skills.description_zh: 将自然语言工作单起始描述转为结构化受理评估，输出确定的 HOLD 暂停事项及后续问题。

skills.name: work-order-posture
skills.description: Turn a normalized Work Order intake into a visible default safety posture map for operator review.
skills.description_zh: 将规范化的工作单受理结果转成可见的默认安全状态图，供操作人员评审。

skills.name: work-order-scaffold
skills.description: Convert a normalized Work Order intake object into a governed scaffold with explicit scope fences, anti-goals, acceptance criteria, and HOLDs.
skills.description_zh: 将规范化工作单受理对象转换为受治理的工作骨架，明确范围边界、非目标、验收标准与 HOLD 暂停事项。
